notes: 8 configurations from 6 manufacturers (inTEST Thermal Solutions, MPI Corporation, ESPEC, Lake Shore Cryotronics, Oxford Instruments Plasma Technology, Bluefors) covering temperature forcing, thermal-chuck wafer probing, thermal shock, LHe/LN2 and cryogen-free cryogenic probe stations (incl. an electromagnet station for Hall/magnetotransport), cryogenic ICP etch and a <2 K 300 mm wafer prober; none duplicates data/cryostats (existing Lake Shore CRX-VF/CRX-4K/CPX/FastHall and ESPEC EGNX12 are different models). Accessed 2026-11-01. Research limits: Tavily returned a plan-quota error on the first call and the shared WebSearch budget (200 per turn) was exhausted after 5 searches, so DLTS cryostats (Semilab/PhysTech), Ecopia HMS-5000 Hall systems and humidity climatic chambers could not be sourced; the Ecopia HMS-5300 university user manual was read (80-350 K, 0.55 T permanent magnet, LN2) but it is not a manufacturer document and lacks vacuum/optical data, so it was not used. PDFs were read via WebFetch-saved copies with pdftotext; HTML spec tables via the read-only browser; degree/multiplication signs restored in quotes. Conversions: C -> mK exact (+273150); 4.5 in = 114.3 mm; Torr kept as Torr ('0.00001'). Conservative choices: worst-case stability over the standard range (FWPX/EMPX nitrogen +/-100 mK, CRX-6.5K +/-25 mK); 6-arm CRX-6.5K base 10 K / 10.5-350 K; Bluefors RF bandwidth 18 GHz; EMPX homogeneity 2.6% over 25 mm = 26000 ppm. ThermoStream transition 180 K in approx. 10 s recorded as 1080 K/min (nominal). Judgement calls to review: (1) ThermoStream electrical.sample_connections = true because the cap is used on the DUT at the tester interface (the user's tester provides the wiring); (2) ESPEC TSE-12-A temperature.range stored as -65..+200 C although exposure is in two bands (-65..0 and +60..+200 C); (3) ESPEC optical_access = false because the catalog lists the viewing window as a TSD-only option; (4) Bluefors temperature.range lo = hi = 2 K per the single-stated-temperature rule, so 4 K experiments will read DOES_NOT_MEET on it although the warm end is merely undocumented; (5) CRX-6.5K magnet recorded optional_not_installed (ring magnet kit, no field value). Lake Shore TTPX and PS-100 specification pages were also read (4.4-475 K LHe/LN2, ring magnet optional) but left out as near-duplicates of FWPX/CPX.
